subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report package + audit-period clarification
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: security@acme.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 30 May 2028 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report package + audit-period clarification

Hi Anna,

Hope you’re well — we’re completing a quick compliance review ahead of a contract renewal and would appreciate your help confirming a couple of items so we can advance procurement:

1) SOC 2 Type II report (most recent): a PDF copy of the report is ideal.
2) Bridge letter (if your Type II coverage ended before 2028-05-01): we can accept a PDF/Docx.
3) Audit period: please confirm the report’s covered period (start/end dates).
4) Minimal evidence package: policy summaries (access control, change management), log-sample directions (dates/retention), and a point of contact for any follow-ups.

If you prefer secure transfer, we can accept a presigned S3 link, SFTP (we have instructions here: https://redwood.example.com/shared/sftp-instructions), or a DocuSign envelope for bridge letters.

Goal: receive the report/package by EOD Thu, 31 May so our procurement team can finish review. Below is a minimal package checklist and two one-line reply templates you can use if you want to delegate this internally.

Minimal package (recommended):
- SOC 2 Type II report (PDF)
- Bridge letter (if applicable)
- Control owner map or a 1-page statement of coverage for key controls (auth, logging, change mgmt)
- Contact: name/email/phone for auditor or security POC

One-line templates (pick one):
- "We’ll share the SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter via secure SFTP by EOD tomorrow — point of contact: Anna Li (security@acme.com)."
- "We’ve uploaded the Type II report to a presigned S3 link; see attached link. Auditor contact: audits@kpmg.com."

Thanks — if sending files now, please attach or indicate preferred transfer method.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0199

(attachment: SOC2_TypeII_Minimum_Package.pdf (pdf), Bridge_Letter_Sample.docx (docx))

- We have a SOC 2 Type II report covering 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31 (issued 2028-03-02).
- No bridge letter was issued for 2028; we can provide a short attestation instead if that helps.
- Minimal package available: report PDF and a one-page controls coverage summary.

Delivery options: we can upload to your SFTP (please share creds), provide a presigned S3 link (preferred), or share via secure Box folder. Auditor contact is: KPMG audits <audits@kpmg.com>.

Hi Anna — perfect, thanks for the quick response. That coverage window (2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31) is fine — procurement typically needs either:

A) Type II report that covers the most recent completed year (PDF) OR
B) Type II report + bridge letter that extends coverage into the renewal window.

If you only have the report + controls summary, that covers our needs for contract review. Procurement will request the auditor contact for verification; please include KPMG audits in the package if possible.

Delivery preference: presigned S3 link works best. If you can upload there, please:
- Include the PDF named: Acme_SOC2_TypeII_2027.pdf
- Include a 1-page controls-summary: Acme_controls_2027_summary.pdf
- Add the auditor contact in a short text file: auditor_contact.txt (audits@kpmg.com)

We’ve attached a short sample bridge letter and a minimal package checklist to this email to speed things up. If you need a DocuSign flow for an attestation, we can initiate that as well.

Target: EOD tomorrow if feasible. If you’ll need longer, what’s the earliest you can share?

Thanks — looping Ben and Marissa to coordinate procurement intake.

Best,
Jonas
